snippet.title: Temtem Swarm 1.0 Available Now on Steam and Steam Deck!
snippet.description:
Temtem: Swarm is out now on Steam, Steam Deck and PlayStation 5, with full support for cross-platform play!

Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

A version for the Nintendo Switch is also in development and will arrive at a later date!

Jump into the Swarm or pick up where you left off here: http://crm.gg/pkgta
Step into the fray on PlayStation 5: http://crm.gg/varfc

🔶 Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/temtem
🔶 Subscribe to the Temtem Newsletter: http://crm.gg/6d9wa

💠 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PlayTemtem/
